objective: Verify data types, row-major layout, and pitch semantics of the future Ascend-C candidate.
observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and read the kernel body and parameter declarations.
pass_condition: Pass iff the candidate uses binary32 elements, i32 scalars, row stride pitch, and logical width/height bounds, and does not require cudaTextureObject_t.
setup: Inspect the candidate kernel signature and indexing expressions; confirm element type is float32, scalar parameters are signed 32-bit, and row indexing uses y*pitch+x while the column count is logical width.
